text:
Nina: dropping a short sync on the compact compare iteration I just uploaded: https://redwood.mock/compare/compact-v5. Main asks: (1) pin CTA placement in the row (left vs inline with version), (2) badge label brevity vs clarity, and (3) how many chips to show before collapsing.
Omar: Quick take 1 1: put the pin inline next to the version string. keeps row actions grouped and reduces mouse travel. On mobile it becomes an overflow menu item.
Bea: Badge microcopy: surface plain numbers with units ("120 ms") and a visually subtle qualifier "typ." or an icon. Put the statistical labels (p50/p95, sample size) in tooltip. Avoid showing p50 on surface because non-technical users ask what p50 means.
Felix: For chips, show up to 4 filters as individual chips. Collapse beyond that into a focusable "+N" trigger. The +N should not only open visually but also be keyboard-accessible and announce its contents.
aria-checker: Accessibility notes: +N trigger must have aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded state. When list opens, focus should move to the list and the component should populate an aria-live="polite" region with the items e.g., "Filters: quantized, short-context, safety". Pin toggle must have an aria-pressed attribute and an accessible label like "Pin version for project".
Marta: UX copy for pin modal: current text reads "Confirm pin". Recommend: title = "Pin model version for project" body = "This pins version v12.3 for this project. If unavailable, we'll fall back to a compatible variant." Action = "Pin version". Show Version ID in small monospaced text.
Nina: Edge-case: what happens if a pinned version is incompatible with Dedicated reserved capacity? We should surface a warning in the pin modal if customer is on Dedicated and the pinned variant requires a different hardware profile. Adding that to the copy and a small checklist would help.
Omar: Good catch. Add a line: "Note: This version may require X GPU type. If not available on your Dedicated pool we'll route to the nearest compatible variant or notify you"
Bea: Visual affordance: pinned rows should show a left-edge chip that reads "Pinned" with a pin icon and tooltip "Pinned for project". Make sure the chip is in the tab order and toggles with Space.
Felix: Also recommend an undo snackbar after pin/unpin with an action "Undo" for 5s. Keyboard users should be able to dismiss via Esc and still undo via a focusable button.
Marta: For badges contrast: small white text on bright capsules flagged in our a11y run. Options: darker capsule, bold text, or adding a 1px inner shadow. Prefer darker capsule + icon to avoid color-only semantics.
aria-checker: Confirmed: darker background (#D64242 -> #B23131) brings contrast to 4.5:1 for 12px normal weight. Adding icon improves non-color signaling.
Nina: Action items: (1) pin CTA inline next to version + modal copy update with Version ID and Dedicated warning; (2) badges surface "120 ms" + microtag/icon, tooltip with p50/p95/n; (3) show up to 4 chips, then +N with keyboard focus and aria-live announcements; (4) pinned row left-chip + undo snackbar; (5) darker badge color + icon.
Omar: I'll update the spec and add acceptance criteria for keyboard / screenreader behavior.
Bea: I'll push microcopy variants and the Figma slice for the compact row.
Felix: I'll prototype the +N interaction and undo snackbar.
Marta: I'll add QA test cases for Dedicated warning scenario and accessibility checks.
Nina: Target: have Figma + specs by Wed EOD so eng can pick up in next sprint. Thanks all :sparkles:
